description: This file defines the TracingDispatcher class, which is responsible for managing tracing operations within the Playwright server. It includes methods to start, stop, and group tracing, as well as handling chunked tracing data.

classes.name: TracingDispatcher
classes.description: A dispatcher class that manages tracing-related protocol calls and lifecycle for a tracing recorder object within a browser context or API request scope.

methods.name: tracingStart
methods.description: Initiates the tracing process with specified parameters.

methods.name: tracingStartChunk
methods.description: Starts a new chunk of tracing data, returning the associated artifact.

methods.name: tracingGroup
methods.description: Creates a grouping context for tracing, optionally with a name and location.

methods.name: tracingStopChunk
methods.description: Stops the current chunk of tracing and returns the artifact and entries.

ctags.name: TracingDispatcher
ctags.pattern: /^export class TracingDispatcher extends Dispatcher<Tracing, channels.TracingChannel, BrowserConte/

ctags.name: artifact
ctags.pattern: /^    const { artifact, entries } = await this._object.stopChunk(progress, params);$/

ctags.name: entries
ctags.pattern: /^    const { artifact, entries } = await this._object.stopChunk(progress, params);$/
